title: Career page
content:
The Zentrale Stelle Verpackungsregister (Central Agency Packaging Register – ZSVR) is pursuing ambitious objectives, reducing the impact of packaging waste on the environment and ensuring that packaging recycling costs are covered – and that's where you come in. Support us in making sure that companies assume responsibility and fulfil their packaging law obligations. Join us in promoting greater transparency and fair competition and become part of a startup-like team: agile, digital and committed to sustainability.

An open and appreciative environment where teamwork and mutual support are highly valued

Regular team events to strengthen team spirit and company culture

Flat hierarchies through direct communication and quick decision-making

Meaningful work that goes beyond merely completing tasks to create genuine value

Agile working methods for dynamic projects

Attractive and fair remuneration

Capital-forming benefits (vermögenswirksame Leistungen) for securing your future

Discounted public transport tickets (Jobticket or Deutschlandticket) for convenient and sustainable public transit travel to work and leisure

Attractive bike leasing options for eco-friendly commuting to work

Flexible working time models tailored to your individual needs

Hybrid working that allows you to choose between the office and home for greater flexibility in your daily routine

Time off in lieu to compensate for overtime work

Workplace health and social counselling to assist with personal matters

Discounted Hansefit membership for access to gyms and wellness offerings

Healthy and productive work environments thanks to ergonomic workplaces

Support for personal and professional growth through tailored training opportunities

Collaboration in a diverse array of projects with cross-disciplinary teams
